scope: Historical original source-package checks; later UI revisions and native work are summarized separately.
later_revision_scope: Bounded toast layout and deferred retiring UI controls; no simulation, accounting, save-format or Services change.
current_native_summary: See NATIVE_QA.json; source-model checks alone establish no native/production/physical-device acceptance.
limits: Physical devices and physical tablets were not tested; phone and logical-tablet layouts used one Android emulator.
Audible output was not tested; the emulator audio output was disabled.
Interactive Web, Web audio/WebGL, production services, signing/consent and human gameplay balance were not verified.
Daily-specific watch victory/once-day bonus and current-build unearned SDK dismissal were not verified. Historical gift/quest/upgrade and unearned-ad observations are separately qualified.
Godot 4.5.1 Compatibility exports used minimum API24/target API35; this does not establish current Google Play eligibility.
